name: India Petroleum API
one_liner: Free, keyless REST API for official daily petrol and diesel retail prices in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata since 16 June 2017, from the PPAC metro price table.

source.name: Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell (PPAC), Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas — RSP of Petrol and Diesel in Metro Cities since 16.6.2017 (daily PDF)
source.license: PPAC terms: material may be reproduced free of charge if reproduced accurately, not in a misleading context, and with the source prominently acknowledged (https://ppac.gov.in/terms-conditions).

not_provided: prices for cities other than Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata
fuels other than petrol and diesel (no LPG, CNG, ATF or kerosene)
state-wise prices, taxes, VAT, excise or dealer commission breakdowns
prices before 16 June 2017, when daily pricing started
monthly petroleum consumption, production and trade statistics (planned, not live)
a guarantee of the pump price on a date (PPAC says a daily change applies from 6:00 AM)

stack.backend: express 5, stored JSON read at start, no database
stack.ingestion: GitHub Actions downloads the PPAC PDF, parses it with pdftotext -raw and commits data/fuel/*.json
